scope: Known controlled decoder behaviors. Designers knew the retained outcomes. This is a cost-constrained reacquisition, not a blind fault challenge.
word_order: breadth first by suffix length, then the declared alphabet order
case_admission_to_schedule: Only complete cases fitting the remaining cap; stop before the first non-fitting case. Do not reorder, pad, truncate, or reuse a decoder across cases.
strict_point_selection: All shared positive cumulative costs of complete prefixes up to the common cap, derived from costs alone before fresh execution.
retained_depth_curve: A separate post-acquisition recount of all retained words of suffix depth zero through four; it is not fresh execution.
cost_unit: Actual calls entering the tested Pipeline.extract method, including typed rejections and raised errors, measured by a local acquisition wrapper.
coverage_unit: A declared controlled implementation is exposed when a retained complete case produces at least one admitted INCONSISTENT obligation. Scientific INADMISSIBLE and acquisition errors remain separately counted.
limitations: A tested extraction call is not equal to a native command, build, wall time, or independent statistical sample.
The cap comparison spends 27 catalog calls and 25 BFS calls when acquisitions complete; it is not an equal-spending comparison.
The strict equal-spending comparisons use only complete prefixes at 1, 13, 19, and 22 calls.
Latch thresholds count cumulative wrong-key rejections within one decoder; correct-key calls do not reset them.
Two passes are repeat acquisitions under the same controlled conditions, not independent populations.
Tool or acquisition failure is retained; no replacement case or adaptive search order is introduced.
